events.description: Deadpool fires two handguns from a rooftop, with visible muzzle flashes and ejected shell casings in frames f10–f12; the shots strike the seated mourners in frames f13–f15, causing violent reactions and chaos.
Deadpool fires two handguns from a rooftop; muzzle flash and ejected shell casing visible at 5.0s and 5.5s.
Deadpool fires multiple shots at a funeral gathering; visible muzzle flashes and smoke at 6.5s–7.0s, with chairs and people reacting to impacts.
Deadpool shoots from atop a gravestone; visible muzzle flash at 10.0s, followed by a man being struck in the head with explosive blood/splatter at 11.0s–11.5s.

Deadpool is shown aiming and firing a pistol from atop a gravestone; muzzle flash is visible in frame f6 (10.5s) and the gun is extended in firing posture in f7 (11.0s), consistent with a shot being fired.

A violent explosion occurs at the location of the man in the suit, evidenced by his head violently recoiling, blood and debris erupting upward in frame f7 (11.0s) and continuing in f8 (11.5s). This follows immediately after the shooting action and appears to be the result of the gunshot impact.

Deadpool engages in a physical confrontation with an opponent in a cemetery: he is seen attacking (f1), the opponent flees (f2–f3), Deadpool pursues and climbs a gravestone (f4–f5), then shoots (f6–f7), culminating in the opponent’s explosive demise (f7–f8). The sequence constitutes mutual aggressive engagement, satisfying the definition of fighting.
